purpose: Recover and independently inventory the 1863 Frenkel source before mapping its Hebrew wording to public-domain Brenton LXX verse boundaries. No Hartom wording or boundaries supply this inventory.
status: source identity and all printed section labels visually checked; full words and vowel-point proofreading pending

scan.bodyPointing: Printed Hebrew is pointed throughout the Letter; unpointed Wikisource text cannot supply the retained printed vowel marks.
scan.rendering: DjVuLibre 3.5.28 ddjvu -format=ppm -subsample=1, then lossless PNG. No OCR, sharpening, or guessed pixels.

inventory.starts: Book title אגרת ירמיהו follows the end of 2 Maccabees. The epistolary opening וזאת משנה הספר is numbered א.
inventory.ends: Section טז continues on page114. The bottom catchword אליליהם is not an extra body occurrence.
Section לט continues on page115. Bottom catchword ולא is not an extra body occurrence.

inventory.starts: ולא יפדו איש מצרתו׃ completes section לט.
inventory.ends: Section ס continues on page116 after את־. Bottom catchword הפסילים is not an extra body occurrence.

inventory.starts: הפסילים כשאר קורי הבית׃ completes section ס.
inventory.ends: Section עט closes the book with לא יכלם לעולם ועד׃. The bottom catchword שפטו belongs to the next book.

labelReview.conclusion: The duplicate לח at digital ordinal35 is not present in the 1863 print. The print has לה, followed by לו, לז, לח. Preserve the raw digital snapshot while correcting the selected source label against the print.

transcriptionWarnings: Digital source contains modernized full spelling and punctuation; do not treat an unpointed digital section as an exact transcription of the pointed 1863 print.
Digital source section2 reads לה after חטאותיכם; the print reads ליי, with printed vowel marks. This is a source error to correct from the scan.
Frenkel section3 visibly says דור העשירי. Retain Frenkel wording even where Brenton differs; boundaries do not authorize translating or changing source words.
Page catchwords are navigational duplication and must not enter the scripture body.
All 79 source sections require semantic mapping to the chosen 73 Brenton units; this inventory does not claim those boundaries are verified.
